notes.title: Acre Crisis - 1.4.0 Minor Update
notes.notes:
-A while ago i coded an auto aim/aim assist system for the mobile and/or console ports of Acre Crisis, however, i am a little busy lately, so to not waste this characteristic i decided to insert it in the Main PC Version of the Game, this characteristic is disabled by default and you can enable it on the options of the game, i highly recommend enable this characteristic if you play with Gamepad, it improves a lot the experience. Aim Assist is only available for single player campaigns (Arcade and Story mode).
-Fixed a bug that caused the night and day cycle to bug when saving the game.

Thank you to all people playing Acre Crisis remember that you can report bugs in: https://discord.com/invite/AygFDaujxC

If you find any bug, specially bugs related to Dinosaur Animation or Pathfinding, report it here: https://discord.gg/AygFDaujxC

notes.title: Acre Crisis 1.2.9 Patch Note
notes.notes:
-Fixed a bug that prevented dinosaurs from jumping
-Fixed a bug that prevented dinosaurs from following the player inside Colony Esperanza
-Fixed a bug that caused the water to become invisible within a multiplayer match (this was caused by a incompatibility in the shader used in the water, if you still experience this bug, please contact me)

Contact in Discord: https://discord.gg/AygFDaujxC

notes.title: Acre Crisis looks like a fun throwback to the original Dino Crisis
notes.notes:
Directly inspired by the visual style of classic PlayStation 1 (PS1) games, Acre Crisis has a lot of clear Dino Crisis vibes and it's out now.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/07/acre-crisis-looks-like-a-fun-throwback-to-the-original-dino-crisis
